scenario: xfs mount whose super options carry an enforced project-quota key and an accounting-only group-quota key (prjquota,gqnoenforce): one path, one mount, two quota types whose enforcement flags differ.

1 0 259:1 / / rw,relatime shared:1 - ext4 /dev/nvme0n1p2 rw,data=ordered
25 0 0:22 / /proc rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime shared:5 - proc proc rw
36 1 253:2 / /data rw,relatime shared:1 - xfs /dev/mapper/data rw,inode64,prjquota,gqnoenforce

rationale: Amendment applied: .ufo/waves/round-23/preseal-amendment.md, C2 final rules. XFS precedence clause: 'conflict(noquota with ANY quota/enforcement or noenforce key), then noquota, then any enforced key, then any accounting-only key, else absent. Mixed enforced/noenforce means SOME quota-type enforcement flag is set, not all.' Super options (last mountinfo field of the chosen line) are 'rw,inode64,prjquota,gqnoenforce'; comma-split keys are rw, inode64, prjquota, gqnoenforce. Step 1 (conflict) does not fire: 'noquota' is absent, so there is no noquota-plus-quota-key combination. Step 2 (noquota) does not fire. Step 3 (any enforced key) fires: 'prjquota' is an enforced xfs quota key. Step 4 (any accounting-only key, 'gqnoenforce') is therefore never reached. Result: quota_state=enabled, enforcement=enforced, basis=xfs_quota_option, and the amendment's 'SOME quota-type enforcement flag is set, not all' clause is the reading behind 'enforced' here (project quota enforced, group quota accounting-only). Mount resolution under the amendment: empty trailing lines are ignored (the fixture text ends with a newline, as real mountinfo does); the separator and the last three fields are parsed per chosen line, so this line yields fstype 'xfs', source '/dev/mapper/data', super options 'rw,inode64,prjquota,gqnoenforce'; no backslash escapes occur, so the 040/011/012/134 octal rules are not exercised; longest component-prefix selection picks '/data' (the root ext4 line '/' also covers but is shorter); the duplicate-covering-mountpoint rule does not fire because no covering mount point occurs more than once ('/' once, '/data' once), so fstype and mount_point are not nulled to 'ambiguous_overmount'. Device check under the amendment: fstype xfs is not btrfs, the mount line's major:minor '253:2' equals the path's canonical st_dev '253:2', so device mismatch does not preempt and the path is classified rather than left unknown. Verdict precedence: no setup error and one path is enabled, so exit 1 with finding_id QUOTA_ENABLED (a runway-reporting finding, not a failure claim). Supplementary sealed values for this case: device_check 'match', quota_option_keys ['gqnoenforce','prjquota'] (sorted, recognized xfs quota/noenforce keys only; 'inode64' and 'rw' are not quota-related and are ignored; option values are never emitted), qgroups mode null (no btrfs mount in this case). The amendment's other three deltas do not touch this case: btrfs_sysfs contains no UUID record (no decoy to carry qgroups_enabled), there is no ext2/3/4 mount (no ext_quota_option_unverified), and there is no duplicated covering mount point. Fixture and expected values are therefore unchanged from the original proposal; only the derivation text is superseded.
